title: Run analytics: the stats fingerprint is replay's own counters (one source of truth, never a second opinion), type counts match the raw stream and sum to the event total, the planned tool profile (4 calls, 1 planned failure) is visible, per-tool pairing sums to the call count with the failed read_file named, think is counted as the tool it is, the wall-clock span is reported but never graded, re-renders are byte-identical, the empty journal reports the zero state, a torn tail is reported honestly with the prefix still counted, and the CLI contract (0 = report, 1 = missing file) holds
